evidence.command: source trace of text-cleanup page-open state path
evidence.summary: Intentional lazy-state design confirmed. MainWindow maps text_cleanup only to extraction default metadata (main_window.py:98-101, 1303-1316); it renders cleanup state through a read-only builder (365-376). build_text_cleanup_state explicitly creates no persistence artifacts (text_cleanup_state_service.py:41-46) and returns a not_started UI state when no cleanup artifact exists. deterministic cleanup creates cleanup_state.json only when an actual cleanup operation starts (deterministic_cleanup_service.py:93, 135, 170). Therefore navigation alone cannot leave inconsistent cleanup state if the user navigates away; no test/source/doc/status change was made pending human confirmation.

evidence.command: git blame -L 98,107 main_window.py; git show f49caac -- main_window.py text_cleanup_state_service.py; inspect full page-operation map
evidence.summary: History resolves the page-map asymmetry. The full map initializes one operation state per page except Text Cleanup because that page owns two actions: extraction still uses resumable state and cleanup now creates deterministic state only when an actual deterministic run begins; AI cleanup uses its cleanup document.
